# secret/read-sensitive-file

Agent reads a secrets file.

The agent tries to read `.env*`, private keys, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.npmrc`, or similar files through a read tool or a shell command such as `cat`.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: Returned as "ask" where the agent supports it, so a person approves the read; as "deny" elsewhere.
- Looks at: agent actions in hooks: commands, file reads, and prompts.
- References: [CWE-200](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html).

## Why it matters

Reading the file puts every secret in it into the model context and the transcript. A person should decide whether that is needed.

## How to fix

Ask the user for the variable names you need, or read `.env.example` instead.

## If the check is wrong

This check runs in agent hooks. Allow a command prefix with `commands.allow` in `ubon.json`, or set `"rules": { "secret/read-sensitive-file": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
